evidence.title: Donald Trump said prices are ‘all coming down now.’ They’re mostly going up.

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis average-price and Consumer Price Index series
occurrences.quote_span: Prices have decreased in some areas since Trump returned to office, including grocery items such as eggs, bacon and bread and durable goods, including cars.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump's claim that prices and groceries were coming down

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News interview transcript or recording from August 4, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: “I inherited very, very high costs, and they’re all coming down now,” Trump said Aug. 4 on Fox News . “The food, the groceries, it’s all coming down.”
occurrences.speaker: Donald Trump
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump's claim that prices and groceries were coming down

occurrences.checkable_against: Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index releases and documented Iran war timeline
occurrences.quote_span: Since the Iran war began Feb. 28, however, year-over-year inflation has spiked.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump's claim that prices and groceries were coming down

occurrences.checkable_against: Bureau of Labor Statistics June 2026 Consumer Price Index release

occurrences.subject: Donald Trump's claim that prices and groceries were coming down
